title: VeriBugBench: An Empirically Grounded Framework for Constructing Verilog RTL Debugging Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2609.18022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RTL source-level debugging research requires benchmark artifacts that provide faulty designs together with precise change locations, executable test stimuli, and reproducible configurations. Available Verilog resources usually provide only a subset of these elements. We present VeriBugBench, a framework for constructing Verilog RTL debugging benchmarks through empirically grounded fault construction, LLM-based testbench enhancement, and execution-based retention. The mutation library maps recurring, multi-granularity repair patterns observed in RTL bug-fix histories to 19 executable inverse operators. For each project, an LLM generates a design-specific stimulus phase from the clean DUT and original testbench; the phase is composed with the original testbench for candidate execution. translated_title: VeriBugBench：一个基于实证的Verilog RTL调试基准构建框架
translated_abstract: RTL源码级调试研究需要能够同时提供故障设计、精确变更位置、可执行测试激励以及可复现配置的基准工件。现有的Verilog资源通常仅提供这些要素中的一部分。我们提出了VeriBugBench，这是一个通过基于实证的故障构造、基于大语言模型（LLM）的测试平台增强以及基于执行的保留机制来构建Verilog RTL调试基准的框架。该变异库将RTL缺陷修复历史中反复观察到的多粒度修复模式映射为19个可执行的逆算子。对于每个项目，LLM根据干净的DUT和原始测试平台生成设计特定的激励阶段；该阶段与原始测试平台组合用于候选故障的执行验证。将该框架应用于45个开源项目，构建得到VeriBugBench-v1.0，其中包含2,608个可执行的单故障实例，其故障效果可在……
tldr: VeriBugBench是一个基于实证的Verilog RTL调试基准构建框架，通过将RTL缺陷修复历史中的修复模式映射为19个可执行逆算子、利用LLM增强测试平台并结合基于执行的筛选，从45个开源项目中构建出包含2,608个可执行单故障实例的VeriBugBench-v1.0基准。
en_tdlr: VeriBugBench is an empirically grounded framework for constructing Verilog RTL debugging benchmarks that maps recurring RTL bug-fix patterns to 19 executable inverse operators, enhances testbenches via LLMs, and applies execution-based retention, yielding VeriBugBench-v1.0 with 2,608 executable single-fault instances derived from 45 open-source projects.
